name: CPU-GPU Hybrid Pipeline with Post-Packing Optimization
aliases: Hybrid CPU-GPU Volume Rendering with Greedy Packing and Post-Packing Optimization
definition: A CPU-GPU hybrid pipeline for volume rendering that performs CPU pre-processing to pack volume data into memory-optimised 2D slices and GPU rendering via 3D texture mapping, mitigating memory inflation caused by hardware constraints requiring uniform 3D texture dimensions.
summary: This hybrid pipeline mitigates GPU memory bottlenecks by using CPU pre-processing to pack non-empty voxels into memory-optimized 2D slices, followed by GPU rendering.
